title: x402 #3866 — Argus Agent Test Lab cross-check of PR #3920: A5 closed, A10a/A10b and A11 open
quote: A10a/A10b — the first-call race (explicit and first-accepted variants). Two concurrent first calls on the same resource both pass the empty-ledger check and both reach the signer before the binding is recorded: two signatures in a window that must admit exactly one. ... A11 — an unsupported expectation silently passes. With the expectation pinned at 0.01, the non-atomic representation 0.5 passes the enabled expectation check and signs — 50× the pinned price, no typed rejection, no fail-closed path.

title: @x402/core pins zod ^3.24.2, so GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5 (high) has no fix path downstream
quote: GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5 (CVE-2023-54404, high, CVSS 7.5: memory exhaustion when validating a large array with no length limit) is fixed only in zod 4.6.6, and there is no patched 3.x. So every project that depends on @x402/core and runs npm audit --audit-level=high in CI has to either fail the build or allowlist the advisory indefinitely.

title: GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5 (zod, all 3.x) puts every @x402 install at multiple high in npm audit — bump needed in @x402/core + @x402/evm
quote: The advisory GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5 flags all zod < 4.6.6. There is no patched 3.x release, and @x402/core@2.28.0 (the latest) still declares zod: "^3.24.2", so every consumer install of @x402/* now reports multiple high severity entries in npm audit.
